description:
Liquidity snapshot for a token's primary trading pair: price, 24h volume, pair count and the chains it trades on. Optional trade_activity reports buys plus sells in the last hour and the preceding five hours from that selected pool's raw integer counts. Missing counts are omitted; observed zeros remain zero.
For native change estimates, pass the previous comparison_context unchanged (or [] to start). The server selects the latest comparable client observation with the same token, chain, complete pool ID and provider, and separately discloses a change from the most recent selected pool. It never subtracts different pools or providers, and refuses stale fallback. Context is bounded client observation, not signed service history. No server history is stored. Legacy calls remain snapshots. The local examples/liquidity_compare.py CLI remains available for saved replies. checked_at is reply time; source data may be cached.
Check 'status' before using the numbers. 'ok' means usable upstream data, not independently verified reserves or executable sell depth. The optional liquidity_reserve_check marker says 'not_checkable' when a positive selected estimate has no computable reserve cap. A missing marker never asserts that reserves, prices or an exit trade were independently verified. 'unavailable' means the upstream request failed, which does NOT mean the token has no liquidity. 'not_found' means no trading pair exists for this address at all. 'unpriced' means pairs exist but no source has costed them, so liquidity_usd is null and the depth is unknown -- this is NOT a report of zero liquidity. 'drained' means every pool on the token's own chain reports its depth and every one is empty: there is nothing to sell into.

chain_hint.description: Optional chain name; disambiguates forks that share addresses

comparison_context.description: Optional client-carried observations, at most 8 and 8192 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Pass a prior comparison_context unchanged, or [] to start. These are client observations, not signed service records. No server history is stored.

name: get_token_liquidity

best_pair_address.description: Optional complete validated selected-pool ID on ok results: 20-byte/32-byte EVM hex or 32-byte Solana base58, preserving case. Omitted for invalid or conflicting identity. Old truncated display IDs cannot establish exact cross-response identity. No sell simulation runs.

checked_at.description: Reply time in ISO-8601 UTC, not the source observation time. Source data may be cached.

comparison.description: Returned when comparison_context is supplied. Uses the latest strictly earlier comparable client observation of this token, chain, complete pool ID and provider. USD estimate change is not a reserve flow or executable depth. Reply times can cover cached source data. A changed pool_transition and baseline_is_latest_observation=false disclose a return to an older pool baseline.

after_checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

before_checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

nonprior_observations.description: Client observations at or after the current reply time; excluded as baselines.

previous_checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

comparison_context.description: Optional client-carried observations, at most 8 and 8192 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Pass a prior comparison_context unchanged, or [] to start. These are client observations, not signed service records. No server history is stored.

liquidity_reserve_check.description: The positive upstream estimate was retained, but its reserve amounts could not be checked. Absence of this marker makes no verification claim.

served_stale.description: Present only when an upstream was unreachable and this answer used cached data. Each entry names the source and how many seconds old it was.

source.description: Liquidity data provider, not the trading venue.

trade_activity.description: Buys plus sells for this pool in the last hour and the five hours before it, as of the listing observation. Omitted when the provider's counts are missing or inconsistent.

title: Get Token Liquidity
